description: During a wide-ranging interview on KMOG Radio, Senator Wendy Rogers discussed her campaign for re-election, reflected on her legislative accomplishments, and shared her priorities for Arizona’s future. She highlighted her work on public safety, election integrity, and border security, addressed recent legal victories protecting free political speech, and emphasized her commitment to serving the people
title: Wendy Rogers Discusses Election Integrity, Public Safety, and Arizona’s Future on KMOG | Wendy Rogers
